brief_description: Bria's new image model for extracting specified objects

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Source image to extract from. Accepts JPEG, JPG, PNG, or WEBP, as a publicly accessible URL or a base64 data URI. No limit on input size or resolution.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Natural-language description of the object to extract (e.g. 'the red car'). When similar elements appear in the image, be specific to disambiguate, e.g. 'the sneaker on the left' rather than 'the sneaker'.

parameters.name: autocrop
parameters.description: When enabled, the output canvas is tightened around the extracted object. When disabled, the cutout is returned on a canvas matching the input image dimensions.

parameters.name: remove_background
parameters.description: Controls how the cutout's alpha channel is refined. When enabled, the segmentation result is refined with background removal for softer, matte-quality edges. When disabled, the segmentation mask is used directly as the alpha, which is faster and avoids over-trimming text, logos, or graphics.
